messages:
Maya (Docs): FYI I opened a docs PR that updates the SDK snippet for model routing + a short migration note for v1.4 -> v1.5. Need a reviewer and timing for the 1.5 cutoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823
Sam (Platform): skimmed the PR — looks clean overall. One code block still shows the old client init.
Alex (Eng): can you paste the snippet here? quick check whether it needs the new RedwoodClient import
Maya (Docs): Sure — current snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client  # old
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='gpt-small', prompt='...')
```
We should change to:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='gpt-small', prompt='...')
```
Alex (Eng): yep, that change plus rename `model` -> `model_variant` in the routing example if you're showing v1/v2 variants.
Sam (Platform): assigning reviewers: Alex (Eng) + Ryan (Release). Also pinging docs-ci-bot to rebuild preview.
docs-ci-bot: Preview build started for PR #4823 — build 1234. Preview: https://ci.preview.redwood.ai/4823
Ryan (Release): Reminder — 1.5 RC cut is Wed 09:00 PT. Docs cutoff is Tue EOD PT. If this is a tiny PR we can slot it into the Tue canary merge window (Tue 22:00 PT). Otherwise it goes after the release. Need green CI + approvals by Tue 16:00 PT to make canary.
Maya (Docs): Added the import & param update, plus a short paragraph in the migration guide about `enable_inference_v2` FF and how to opt a tenant into `model_variant: 'v2'`. Pushed.
Alex (Eng): quick review done — LGTM after changing the example param name in the code fence (I left an inline comment).
Sam (Platform): there's also a nav redirect needed: old URL /docs/sdk/old-init should 301 to /docs/sdk/redwoodclient — can someone file an infra redirect ticket?
Maya (Docs): filed infra ticket INFRA-789 and added a note in the PR description.
Alex (Eng): CI rerun looks green: https://ci/build/1234 — tests + lint passed.
docs-ci-bot: Preview build 1234 succeeded — https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/4823 :white_check_mark:
Maya (Docs): Thanks! Requesting merge during the Tue canary window at 22:00 PT. @Ryan can you hold the slot?
Ryan (Release): I will hold it and watch the canary. If anything flips we'll revert. If approvals don't land by Tue 16:00 PT, we'll move this to the post-release patch.
Sam (Platform): one last request — add an explicit note under the versioned docs that the SDK snippet changed in 1.5 and link to the migration guide (so search/old links don't confuse users).
Maya (Docs): added that line and a short anchor. Pushed again.
Alex (Eng): LGTM. Approving in GitHub.
Maya (Docs): Merged into canary slot. Will monitor preview and release smoke. Thanks everyone.
Ryan (Release): Confirmed merged into the canary slot. I'll monitor the rollout and report back if anything shows up during canary testing.
